messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up 1 opened a small docs PR to update SDK snippets for streaming + pagination across Py/TS/Go. Focus: show multi-page resume with cursor, minimal retry, and a cancel example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233

devin: Love it. Can we show a tiny multi-page loop that saves the cursor between pages (one-liner) so readers see the resume flow? Also call out that the cursor is opaque.

rachel: Yup. Keeping blocks tiny so they render well. Draft examples below.

rachel: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# page through results, save cursor after each page
cur = None
for page in range(3):
    resp = client.generate('gpt-medium', prompt='list items', max_tokens=50, cursor=cur, retry={'strategy':'exp','max_attempts':2})
    print(resp.text)
    cur = resp.cursor  # store opaque cursor to resume
```

rachel: ```ts
// AbortController cancel + resume with saved cursor
const ac = new AbortController(); setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(), 1800)
let cursor = null
for await (const ch of client.stream('gpt-medium', { prompt: 'list items', maxTokens: 50, cursor, signal: ac.signal, retry: { strategy: 'exp', maxAttempts: 2 } })) {
  console.log(ch.text)
  if (ch.meta?.pageCursor) cursor = ch.meta.pageCursor // example: collect page cursor if provided
}
```

rachel: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
cursor := ""
for i:=0;i<3;i++{
  resp := client.Generate(ctx, "gpt-medium", redwood.GenerateOpts{Prompt:"list items", MaxTokens:50, Cursor:cursor})
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
  cursor = resp.Cursor // opaque token, store to resume
}
```

anya: Nice and concise. A couple of suggestions: 1) in TS avoid optional chaining in examples unless we show it elsewhere; use a comment that the SDK may include a pageCursor field. 2) Add one-line note under each block: "Cursor is opaque. Store and pass back as-is to resume."

ci-bot: lint: use `max_tokens` in Python examples; checked imports for Go (`github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go`) OK. Also flagged that the TS snippet referenced `ch.meta` which is hypothetical; recommend adding a clarifying comment.

sam: I'll add a GH Actions `examples-smoke` job that runs the small Python and Go examples (TS run via node harness) behind an env guard to avoid leaking creds. Will skip if REDWOOD_EXAMPLES_KEY not set. ETA today.

devin: I'll update the PR to switch Python param name, add the opaque-cursor note under each snippet, and clarify the TS comment. Then merge once smoke CI passes.

rachel: Thanks all! Will post a short FAQ blurb about the cursor rename (`resume_token` -> `cursor`) to reduce user confusion."
